principle_violations.reason: The UserService class is directly depending on the concrete MySQLDatabase class. This makes the UserService class tightly coupled to a specific database implementation, preventing easy substitution of different database types.
principle_violations.suggestion: Define a Database interface that provides the necessary methods for user data handling. Then, implement this interface in the MySQLDatabase class. UserService should depend on this Database interface, promoting a looser coupling.

principle_violations.reason: The MySQLDatabase class has hard-coded logic for managing user data. Any changes to the database logic require modification of this class, making it not closed for modification.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a Database interface and let MySQLDatabase implement this interface. This allows the class to be extended without modifying the existing code structure.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
